known_results: All v1.0.0 outcomes visible; outcome-conditional illustrative selection, not an unbiased semantic audit.
retained_cases: First preselected QASPER and SciFact one_not_union cases in analysis/representative_examples.json
new_selection: Original QASPER cohort; original strict normalized answer agreement; at least two distinct minimal sets; no strict supersets; original BM25 k=5 C=1,A=0; smallest SHA256 of question ID. Keep first even if interpretation weak.
presentation: exact source IDs, query and recorded answers/label, evidence family, actual ranking prefix, H/C/A/dC/dA, bounded short verbatim excerpts; no independent human validation or semantic population inference.
